title: Internship modules
bodyMd:
Completion requires all module tasks. A participant may be enrolled in more than one module; totals describe enrolments, not unique individuals.

| Category | Module enrolments | Completed enrolments |
|---|---:|---:|
| Analysis | 60 | 42 |
| Design | 100 | 80 |
| Operations | 140 | 112 |
